title: Peterson offered to show Fitts a UFO if she stopped her research

tellings.quote: John Peterson promised to show uh Katherine Austin Fitz a UFO if she would stop engaging in her research.

plain: The podcast host Jesse Michels, speaking with the historian Richard Dolan, said that around 1998 a man named John Peterson, linked to an organisation called the Arlington Institute, made an offer to a woman named Katherine Austin Fitz. As Michels tells it, drawing on a source named Linda Thompson, Peterson promised to show her a UFO if she would stop her research. If true, it would mean someone was trading a look at a UFO to keep her quiet.
